summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing Hong Kong Exchange next-day disclosure returns and a monthly return on securities movements. The filings detail on-market share repurchases executed in July 2026 at prices near USD 1.04–1.09 per share, dozens of tranches of roughly 77,000–135,000 shares each, held as repurchased-for-cancellation shares pending cancellation but not yet canceled as of the October 2026 reporting date. Outstanding shares stand at 244,789,786 following the reported events. The mechanics reflect routine HK buyback reporting; watch the pace of cancellations and any effect on the public float overhang.
